assumptions: Adjacent fragments share terminal homology of at least the stated length.
limits: Predicts the products, not their yield; only the first is emitted as a record.
Does not model exonuclease chew-back, secondary structure or mispriming.
bio.jane/contract.question: What construct do these fragments make when they are joined by their terminal homology (Gibson, NEBuilder, In-Fusion)?

description: Assemble fragments by terminal homology (Gibson / NEBuilder / In-Fusion, DnaCauldron). Emits the first product as a NEW record for downstream nodes.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

expect_no_unused_parts.description: treat a fragment left out of every construct as an error rather than a warning (upstream's own default).

fragments.description: the fragments to assemble — wire upstream `record` outputs here, or list library document names/ids.

include_subject.description: also include the node's subject as a fragment.

max_constructs.description: cap on how many distinct constructs are enumerated, so an ambiguous fragment set cannot run away. Advanced.

max_homology_bp.description: longest terminal homology considered. The bound is EXCLUSIVE, as upstream's own `range(min, max)` is: a maximum of 40 rejects a 40 bp arm. In bp.

max_tm.description: optional ceiling on the same gate scale. 0 = no constraint. In °C. Advanced.

min_homology_bp.description: minimum terminal homology for two ends to join. In bp.

min_tm.description: optional floor on the junction's GATE value (DnaCauldron's naive A/T = 2, G/C = 4 sum, not a nearest-neighbour temperature). 0 = no constraint. In °C. Advanced.

preserve_backbone_origin.description: for circular products, rotate the origin to the start of the backbone fragment and name the product after it. Advanced.

topology.description: product topology to enumerate. Values: circular (Circular), linear (Linear), both (Both).

name: gibson_assemble

errors.description: assembly errors — the structured flaws DnaCauldron's errors spreadsheet is built from

record.description: the first assembled product, as a record
